attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 12 Ιουλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. He is none of the corpus's eight other men of the name — the disciple of Cronides, of Alexandria, of Corinth, of Pentapolis, of Pskov, of Rome, and the two bare ones of 24 May and 21 March: none of those is kept on 12 July, none is burned alive, and none is taken by a ruler named Aquila. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence, and the page prints no hymn. The page names the emperor Severus and no year, so there is no `dates` object.
